faq.q: How long does a Designit engagement take?
faq.a: A design sprint is delivered in five business days, a UX audit in about two weeks, and full product design engagements run four to twelve weeks depending on scope. Retainers are ongoing.

faq.q: Who actually works on the engagement?
faq.a: Senior practitioners from kickoff through developer handoff. There are no account managers in the middle and no junior hand-offs after the contract is signed.

faq.q: Which service should we start with?
faq.a: If you have a live product and something is wrong, start with a UX audit: fixed scope, two weeks and a ranked fix list whether or not you continue. If you are deciding what to build, start with discovery.

faq.q: Which regions does Designit work with?
faq.a: Clients in India and the UAE, and projects for teams in the United States and the United Kingdom. Communication is in English, and invoices are in the client's market currency: INR, USD, GBP or AED. See locations.

faq.q: How do I start a project with Designit?
faq.a: Use the Start a Project form, book a call or email contact@designit.co.in. A tailored scope follows the first conversation.
